# GfxModeWidth <img class="product" src="media/bb-20x14.png" alt="BlitzBasic" title="BlitzBasic" width="20" height="14"> <img class="product" src="media/bp-20x14.png" alt="BlitzPlus" title="BlitzPlus" width="20" height="14"> <img class="product" src="media/b3d-20x14.png" alt="Blitz3D" title="Blitz3D" width="20" height="14">

```blitzbasic
GfxModeWidth:Int32 mode:Int32
```

| Parameter | Mode | Type | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `mode` | In | Int32 | required | The mode number, from 1 to [CountGfxModes](CountGfxModes). |

**Returns:** The width in pixels.

## Description

The width in pixels of a display mode.

## Differences

* A mode number that does not exist stops the program with an error message.
